subject: [PATCH 0/4] btrfs: handle -ENOMEM errors in some synchronous dirops without aborting

reviews.author: Jeff Layton (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged a concern about the later failure mode and agreed to rebase the patch on top of Boris's series, planning to fix the issue in v2.
reviews.raw_body:
I think basing this series on top of yours would make the most sense.
That should take care of your main concern with the later failure mode
since your series should fix most of those cases. I'll plan to rebase
this on top of that series once you resend it.

Thanks!
-- 
Jeff Layton <jlayton@kernel.org>

2026-07-21.patch_summary: This patch addresses a concern about handling ENOMEM errors in btrfs_insert_dir_item() without causing an abort, specifically focusing on whether this approach will lead to further ENOMEM errors in other functions like btrfs_orphan_add(). The patch aims to provide more concrete evidence that this handling strategy is effective and worth the added complexity.
